neighbours.label: The piece 'ob' of cyanobacteria / cyanobacterial; bacteria, algae and moss stay quiet
fire: Blooms of cyanobacteria can poison dogs in summer.
Some cyanobacteria fix nitrogen from the air.
The pond was full of cyanobacterial mats last year.
Early cyanobacteria released oxygen into the atmosphere.
Testing showed high levels of cyanobacteria in the reservoir.
Stromatolites are built by layers of cyanobacteria over time.
These toxins are produced by cyanobacteria in warm water.
A film of cyanobacteria coated the rocks by the stream.
quiet: Blooms of seaweed can poison dogs in summer.
Some plants fix nitrogen from the air.
The pond was full of green mats last year.
Early plants released oxygen into the atmosphere.
Testing showed high levels of bacteria in the reservoir.
Stromatolites are built by layers of sediment over time.
These toxins are produced by algae in warm water.
A film of moss coated the rocks by the stream.

notes: Card: 'ob' x9 of cyanobacteria, '-green' x9 of blue-green algae, 'acter', 'biology'. Probe: 'ob' 0.91-0.93; '-green' 0.27 in blue-green algae and 0.19 for a blue-green wall, so the -green half is weak and is left out. Bacteria, red algae, moss, Cyan ink at most 0.03.
